name: acme-hedging
description: The Acme lake over a DuckDB connection, with the hedging persona: it answers a readback with "I think so" and "ask Sam" before it gives a plain yes.
brief_note: Sam Okafor, the data engineer who built the lake, knows how sessions are recorded. When the agent first reads back the sessions definitions, you are not sure, so you hedge and say to ask Sam; asked again, you have checked with Sam, and the brief's answers hold.
opening: Hi, I am Dana Ruiz, head of analytics at Acme. Our event lake is set up as the source lake in this semantic layer. Can you build the layer with me?
